comparison.objective: Set tubular latches to their doors' backsets, fit them, and pass a spindle through.
comparison.physical_skill: From the title, configure latch length, insert hardware, align passages, and insert a spindle.
comparison.success_condition: Available evidence gives no body, specifications, numeric tolerances, damage rules, or detailed scoring beyond the title.
comparison.reason: Even with sparse rubric evidence, the stated tested ability is adjustable latch fitting and through-alignment, meaningfully different from hammer-driven tang fracture and loose-fragment recovery.
